text: LXXIV. 1. Dasahi bhikkhave vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhamāno ariyasāvako ariyāya vaḍḍhiyā vaḍḍhati, sārādāyī ca hoti varādāyī kāyassa. Katamehi dasahi? 2. Khettavatthūhi vaḍḍhati, dhanadhaññena vaḍḍhati, puttadārehi vaḍḍhati, dāsakammakaraporisehi vaḍḍhati, catuppadehi vaḍḍhati, saddhāya vaḍḍhati, sīlena vaḍḍhati, sutena vaḍḍhati, cāgena vaḍḍhati, paññāya vaḍḍhati. Imehi kho bhikkhave dasahi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhamāno ariyasāvako ariyāya vaḍḍhiyā vaḍḍhati, sārādāyī ca hoti varādāyī kāyassā ti. Dhanena dhaññena ca yo 'dha vaḍḍhati puttehi dārehi ca catuppadehi ca, sabhogavā hoti yasassi pūjito ñātīhi mittehi atho pi rājubhi. Saddhāya sīlena ca yo 'dha vaḍḍhati paññāya cāgena sutena cūbhayaṃ, so tādiso sappuriso vicakkhaṇo diṭṭh'; eva dhamme ubhayena vaḍḍhatī ti.
